result.description:
Orange Giraffe Pty Ltd, trading as The Tattersalls Hotel, is looking for experienced Cooks and Chefs to join the team in the heart of Goulburn, NSW. As a well-loved regional pub, The Tattersalls Hotel is a staple in the community, known for its welcoming atmosphere, great food, and exceptional hospitality.

With full-time positions available, the venue offers a competitive salary of $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, negotiable for the right candidate. This is a fantastic opportunity for skilled kitchen professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and take pride in delivering quality meals.

Scope of Role:
-  Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
-  Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
-  Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
-  Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
-  Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
-  Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
-  Collaborating with other team members to plan and develop recipes and menus, taking into account seasonal ingredient availability and projected customer numbers.
-  Demonstrating new cooking techniques and introducing equipment to staff for continual culinary improvement.
-  Ensure all workstations are properly set up, thoroughly cleaned, and efficiently organised, preparing utensils, ovens, and grills for optimal readiness at the start of each shift.
-  Prepare and cook dishes in strict compliance with food safety and health regulations, ensuring the highest quality and hygiene standards are maintained.
-  Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
-  Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.


To be considered for this role, you should:
-  Proven experience as a Cook or Chef in a busy kitchen.
-   Relevant Qualifications – Certificate III & IV in Commercial Cookery.
-  At least 2-3 years of experience in a similar role.
-  Excellent communication skills and a positive, team-focused attitude.
-  Availability to work weekends and split shifts.
-  Willingness to relocate (if not already based in Goulburn).

What’s in It for You?
-  A supportive and down-to-earth team – Work with like-minded professionals in a friendly environment.
-  Career development and growth – Opportunities to progress within the business.
-  A great lifestyle in regional NSW – Be part of a close-knit community while working in a thriving venue.


The Tattersalls Hotel is more than just a workplace—it’s a place where hard work is valued, and local hospitality shines.
If you or someone you know is looking for a great opportunity in Goulburn, apply today!

How to join the team
Please submit an online application to join our diverse, compassionate and dedicated team for a rewarding career. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or the capacity to work in Australia permanently. A temporary visa holder may only be employed if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. 

For over 170 years, Anglicare has supported people and communities across Sydney and the surrounds. Our Seniors Communities portfolio spans Retirement Living and Support at Home services, supporting thousands of older Australians and their families. 

AsControls and Design Assurance Manager,you'llplay a critical leadership role in safeguarding Anglicare's digital assets,dataand IT infrastructure.You'lllead the Cyber Security Controls Assurance Program, ensuring security controls are designed,testedandmaintainedfor operational effectiveness and compliance.You'llbe welcomed into a compassionate,respectfuland purpose-driven community where wedon'tjust talk about values - we live them.

As part of a purpose-driven organisation, you'll be working in a collaborative and values-led environment where your work directly contributes to enriching lives and strengthening communities. 

Your opportunity

You will lead a team of cyber security professionals and collaborate with IT, legal, compliance and senior leadership to align cyber securitycontrols operational effectivenesswithAnglicare'soverall security posture. From architectural security reviews to vulnerability management and data protection initiatives,you'llensure robust security frameworks that protect our mission.

With ownership, you will:

Develop and oversee Anglicare's Security Controls Assurance Program

Lead security architecture reviews and risk-based design assessments

Ensure secure Identity Governance, Data Loss Protection and Privileged Access Management

Standardise cloud and network security controls across hybrid environments

Oversee vulnerability management and risk mitigation programs

Implement secure DevOps frameworks and compliance in development pipelines

Engage senior stakeholders and provide compliance reporting

What you'll bring

You are a strategic leader with deepexpertisein cyber security controls,governanceand risk management. You bring strong analytical skills, excellentcommunicationand the ability to translate complex security concepts into actionable strategies.

You will also need:

Tertiary qualification in IT, Cyber Security or Risk Management

Proven experience in cyber security, controls assurance and risk governance

Familiarity withCyber Security Frameworks such as SCF(preferred), NIST and ISO 27001

Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement skills

Ability toadvisesenior leadership on cyber security risk and compliance

Why Anglicare?

At Anglicare, we provide meaningful opportunities and choice - both for the communities we support and the people who work with us. 

Here'swhatyou'llenjoy: 

Flexible work options to balance life and career. 

Salary packaging benefits - up to $15,900 of your income tax free, plus $2,650 for meals and entertainment. 

Ongoing professional development and career pathways. 

Exclusive staff discounts with over 400 retailers. 

Employee Assistance Program and Fitness Passport with access to 800+ gyms. 

Belonging to a supportive, purpose-driven team committed to making a difference. 

Apply now

Are you ready to help us attract and empower the people who will shape Anglicare's future? To apply, click the'Apply'button andsubmityour resum and cover letter. All applicants will receive a response. Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the communities we serve. While guided by our Christian values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds.

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders,abilitiesand cultural backgrounds.

We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
